reviews.title: Transparent AI-assisted climate forecast submission
reviews.reviewerNote: Regional climate forecasting bounty: AI-assistance disclosure, provenance, human review, and reproducibility evidence are scoring-ready.

reviews.title: AI-assisted materials model with incomplete provenance

findings.message: An AI-generated component lacks human review attestation.
findings.remediation: Add human review evidence before the component can be scored or released to a sponsor.

findings.message: An AI-generated component does not include a provenance or artifact hash.
findings.remediation: Add a stable artifact hash, prompt digest, or build provenance digest.

reviews.reviewerNote: Materials discovery bounty: REVIEW before scoring because an ai-generated component lacks human review attestation.

reviews.title: Undisclosed AI-generated solver report

findings.message: The submission used AI assistance without the disclosure required by the challenge policy.
findings.remediation: Require an explicit AI-use disclosure before scoring, award release, or sponsor handoff.

findings.message: AI-assisted work lacks a completed human review attestation.
findings.remediation: Add named reviewer, review date, reviewed components, and residual-risk notes.

findings.message: The submission lacks reproducibility commands or environment notes for AI-assisted deliverables.
findings.remediation: Add commands, environment, seeds, and artifact hashes sufficient for sponsor-side reproduction.

findings.message: The submission used an AI/tooling system that is not listed in the challenge-approved tool policy.
findings.remediation: Add sponsor approval evidence for the tool or rerun the affected work with an approved toolchain.

findings.message: An apparent AI tool is present in provenance records but not listed as disclosed.
findings.remediation: Update the solver disclosure packet so reviewers can see which AI tools touched the deliverable.

findings.message: An AI-generated component is not clearly disclosed in the submission packet.
findings.remediation: Mark the generated component and explain how it was produced and reviewed.

findings.message: An AI-generated component lacks human review attestation.
findings.remediation: Add human review evidence before the component can be scored or released to a sponsor.

findings.message: An AI-generated component does not include a provenance or artifact hash.
findings.remediation: Add a stable artifact hash, prompt digest, or build provenance digest.

reviews.reviewerNote: Single-cell biomarker bounty: HOLD before scoring because the submission used ai assistance without the disclosure required by the challenge policy.

reviews.title: Private sponsor data sent through AI workflow

findings.message: AI assistance appears to have used data classes prohibited by the challenge policy.
findings.remediation: Hold the packet, notify the sponsor, and require a clean-room rerun or documented exception.

findings.message: The AI workflow or final packet includes private or sponsor-restricted data.
findings.remediation: Remove private data, regenerate affected artifacts, and provide reviewer-safe provenance evidence.

findings.message: The packet appears to expose prompts, secrets, bearer tokens, or private workflow instructions.
findings.remediation: Redact the packet, rotate any exposed credentials if real, and resubmit reviewer-safe evidence only.

findings.message: A generated component uses a license outside the challenge submission policy.
findings.remediation: Relicense, remove, or obtain sponsor approval before scoring the submission.
